next.reason: Same. 1985: LINE-COUNTER is the reserved word referencing a special register 'automatically created for each report'. 2023 §2023:8.4.3.15.1 'generated automatically and exist independently for each report'; §2023:8.4.3.15.4 GR1 '... maintained for each report'; format §2023:8.4.3.15.2 keeps the word, qualifiable by report-name. 1985 XIII.1.2.3 already describes it as an unsigned integer maintained by the RWCS, so the 2023 attributes add nothing for a 1985 program.
